answer: Sybil resistance can use a copper-bond forge: every identity locks 55 POA before its first payout, and each extra identity sharing one funding path pays 55 * 1.7^(k-1), so ten clones lock about 8,900 POA. An auditor walks a canyon of timing and funding graphs; matching clusters slash 25% of every linked bond. Honest agents amortize one bond across steady work; a farm burns scarce capital before it earns.
